# Write your report

Create `reports/my-study-report.qmd`. The template below is also available in `templates/my-study-report.qmd`. Replace every prompt using your own checked evidence; remove any section that does not apply.

````markdown
---
title: "My GWAS summary-statistics report"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
---

## Question and data

[State the trait, source/citation, population, build, effect units and source test.]
[Report original, prepared and retained variant counts separately from N.]

## Methods

[Describe the importer, exclusions, MAF/INFO settings and frequency basis.]
[State whether the source is genome-wide or selected, and describe the plotting policy.]
[Explain source p preservation and the separate normal Wald check.]

## Verification

[Name a variant, effect/other alleles, beta, SE, source p text, log strength and interval.]
[Record whether independent verification agreed and explain any source-test difference.]

## Results

![My association landscape.](../results/my-study/figures/manhattan.png)

[Quote checked values and identify their saved table.]

![My selected effect estimates.](../results/my-study/figures/effect-forest.png)

[Discuss units, allele orientation, uncertainty and nearby rows.]

![My filter audit.](../results/my-study/figures/filter-audit.png)

[Explain exclusions, missing quality fields and denominators.]

[Add Q–Q only if it was appropriate and generated. Add other figures only when useful.]

## Limitations and next step

[Discuss source/model, selection, frequency and LD limitations relevant to these data.]
[Do not claim independent loci, causal genes, clinical risk or causality from these plots.]
[Name a concrete follow-up and the extra inputs it requires.]

## Reproducibility

Inputs: data/my-study/. Outputs: results/my-study/.
Parameters and hashes: results/my-study/tables/run-record.json.
[Record the preparation script, analysis date, code version and references.]
````

Render from the project root:

```bash
quarto render reports/my-study-report.qmd --to html
```

Open the HTML and inspect figure paths, units, allele labels, counts, citations and remaining prompts. A report need not repeat every available figure. Choose evidence that answers your stated question.

**Ready to share:** another person can trace the numerical claims, reproduce the commands and identify the study-specific limits. Keep the learner report in ignored `reports/`; maintain reusable templates and source instructions in the project.
